artworks.title: The Angel Carrying off Habakkuk by His Hair, Surrounded by an Elaborate Rococo Frame
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite, heightened with white gouache and incised throughout, on two joined sheets of blue laid paper, the verso reddened for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological and allegorical scenes with classical architecture and figures. The image shows intricate details with multiple figures, scrolling ornaments, and architectural elements. The centerpiece depicts a figure being guided by an ethereal being. Surrounding scenes include cherubs, classical figures, vegetation, and architectural structures. Ornate shapes frame the composition and the figures' poses suggest movement and vitality.

artworks.title: The Interior of the Cathedral of Saint Stephen at Vienna
artworks.medium: watercolor with scratching out, partially varnished, on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a painting of the interior of a grand Gothic cathedral with soaring ribbed vaults and intricately carved stone columns, many of which are topped with statues. At the center of the painting is a raised pulpit at the top of a winding spiral staircase. The staircase and the platform itself are both intricately carved from a dark brown material that has golden highlights. Standing in front of the staircase is a woman wearing a blue dress with a pink shawl, her face covered by a white veil decorated with pink details. On the left is another woman holding the hands of two children, a third woman kneeling on the ground near them. More people are visible on the left, standing or sitting near rows of brown pews, illuminated by pale light that filters in through a large window on the left side. The overall color palette of the cathedral is mostly shades of gray and brown, with golden accents and pops of color from the clothes of worshippers.

artworks.title: The Ascension of Christ
artworks.medium: red chalk with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in dynamic and flowing motion. The left figure is mid-air with an arm extended and head turned to the left. The central figure is airborne with garments billowing and an arm raised. The right figure has one knee lifted. Their poses suggest movement. The figures have soft facial features and flowing robes, set against a neutral background.

artworks.title: Children and Goats Resting by a Felled Tree
artworks.medium: pen and brown and some gray ink with watercolor and gouache, a few touches of varnish (gum arabic?) on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A group of children and goats are clustered close to us on a grassy slope. One child is playfully seated on a tree branch that extends across the scene. The horizon is set low in the painting, marked by a distant glimpse of rolling hills under a light blue sky scattered with clouds. The artist uses delicate and precise brushstrokes, lending the scene a soft, illustrative quality. The color palette is dominated by earthy tones of green and brown with highlights of blue and grey in the background, capturing a serene and natural environment. Elements such as a wooden fence and large, gnarled trees frame the composition.

artworks.title: Le Chaos (Chaos)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a series of curving and intersecting lines forming an intricate abstract composition. Swirling arcs and dynamic strokes create a sense of movement. The dark and light shading suggests a dramatic landscape.

artworks.title: La terre (Earth)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with roulette on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a human skull and a ceramic jug on a textured surface. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones and dark shadows. In the background, there is dense foliage, creating a contrast with the foreground. The skull and jug are positioned towards the bottom right, while the foliage fills the upper left of the image.

artworks.title: L'air (Air)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a large, open fan with detailed designs and a tall decorative feather quill standing upright near the center. The color palette is predominantly black and white, indicative of an etching, with various shades of gray depicting shadows and textures. The fan is positioned at the center, occupying most of the space, slightly open in a semi-circular manner. The feather quill rises vertically beside the fan, with its tip near the top edge of the image. Behind these items, there are abstract forms and lines suggesting fabric or textured surfaces, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Le feu (Fire)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a cauldron, a kettle, and bellows on a wooden tabletop. There is a small jug or cup to the right, with other tools in the background. The color scheme is black and white, typical of a monochrome etching.

artworks.title: L'eau (Water)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large pitcher and a bucket prominently in the foreground, along with a basin and a broom. The etching primarily consists of a monochromatic palette in shades of brown and black. The bucket is to the left, filled with water, and the pitcher is to its right, standing behind a basin which holds a small broom bristle. Draped over the edge of the basin to the right is a piece of cloth. A water tap can be seen in the background to the left above the bucket.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 14.5 x 36.2 cm (5 11/16 x 14 1/4 in.)
sheet (unfolded): 26.7 x 72 cm (10 1/2 x 28 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a rectangular plaque with text. The words on it include "Les Quatre Elements", "Eaux-Fortes", "Jules Jacquemart", "1863", and "Paris Cadart & Chevaucher, Editeurs Rue Richelieu No 56". The plaque has an aged appearance with rough edges and is mounted on a blank background with minimal writing.

artworks.title: Spanish Scene (Scène espagnole)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on cream laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features three full-body figures: two women and a man. The man on the left is standing with a slight lean forward, wearing a hat and period clothing with detailed features. The woman next to him appears to be mid-dance, dressed in an elaborate patterned dress. The second woman on the right is seated or reclining, wearing a similar style dress with styled hair. The background is a blank, light-colored space.

artworks.title: Noah Leading the Animals into the Ark
artworks.artist: François-André Vincent after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: black chalk and brown wash with white gouache on light brown laid paper (originally blue); laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of farm animals and two individuals standing before an ark. The animals include goats, a cow, chickens, and ducks. The two individuals seem to be guiding the animals towards the ark. The scene is in sepia tone with a sketched sky and subtle lighting, creating soft shadows. The composition and style suggest a pastoral or biblical theme.

artworks.title: Gloria
artworks.artist: Domenico del Barbiere after Rosso Fiorentino
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a winged figure standing on clouds with the word "GLORIA" above. The figure appears to be a female with large wings, standing gracefully among swirling clouds. She holds a trumpet in one hand and a banner in the other. The artwork is finely rendered with intricate details, typical of engravings. This is a baroque style scene conveying themes of triumph or victory.

artworks.title: A Path through a Hilly Landscape
artworks.artist: Carl Friedrich Ludwig Felix von Rumohr
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a winding path through rugged terrain, hills, trees, and a cloudy sky. The artwork features detailed etching with a monochromatic sepia color palette, giving it a vintage feel. The path leads through the scene towards rolling hills.

artworks.title: A Landscape with a Herd of Cows and Goats, Surmounted by Another Landscape, Upside-down, with a Man Pushing a Wheelbarrow
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills and foliage. The view is slightly above eye level, giving a downward slope effect. The horizon is high in the composition, creating depth. The brushstrokes are delicate, especially in the trees and leaves. The color palette is sepia. In the foreground, there are cattle and sheep being herded by a figure on a path. A large tree with leafy branches frames the scene.

artworks.title: David and Bathsheba
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and angular shapes in an abstract scene. The shapes resemble a figure seated by a fountain, wrapped in flowing robes that resemble cascading water. The drawing blurs the distinction between fabric and water, hinting at a palace or courtyard. The background includes arch-like curves, vertical lines, and decorative sculptures against the sky.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Virtue and Divine Wisdom
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures among clouds. The figures are depicted with meticulous linework on paper. The central part of the drawing shows figures seated or reclining on clouds, with smaller winged figures hovering around them. Various individuals hold different objects, such as a shield with a sunburst and a spear. The composition features movement in the arrangement of robes and limbs. The clouds around the figures are intricate and swirling. The lines capture expressions and gestures conveying a harmonious assembly.

artworks.title: Three Armed Riders Escorting Prisoners near Reims
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite, with borderlines in pen and black ink, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of individuals traveling on a rugged landscape led by a mounted figure wielding a spear-like weapon. The group is moving along a worn path on a grassy mound under a partly cloudy sky. The central figure on horseback is wearing a dark uniform with red accents and is looking back at the group following behind, who appear to be walking. Among them, one figure is dressed in a light-colored garment, contrasting with the darker outfits of others. The background shows a vast open landscape with a distant structure visible on the horizon. The sky is expansive, with clouds casting shadows, creating a sense of depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: An Allegory of Wisdom and the Arts
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and touches of  black chalk over graphite on laid paper, adhered to an historic mount
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical and architectural scene. Figures are arranged around a large architectural structure. Atop the structure is a column capped with a statue or bust, and a group of figures, including some engaged in activities related to celestial objects, such as manipulating an armillary sphere or holding tools like compasses. Above them, more figures appear to hover in or descend from the sky, with clouds surrounding them. The drawing is detailed with a remarkable use of shade and line, giving a sense of movement and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: Germania
artworks.medium: pen and black, brown, and golden ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure on a bench, with long hair adorned with leaves, draped in an elaborate robe and cloak, holding a book, sword, and shield with an eagle emblem. Other elements include a decorative structure with colorful shields, a golden crown on a pedestal, and a background with a tree, castle, and greenery against a muted sky.

artworks.title: An Elaborate Altar with the Resurrection of Christ and the Martyrdom of Saint Andrew
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design featuring classical elements and decorative figures. The image showcases a frontal view of an altar or monumental wall structure. The architectural element is adorned with relief sculptures, winged figures, garlands, and a central niche containing a scene with a central figure. The composition is symmetrically balanced, with detailed columns, pediments, and pilasters. The side panels hold winged figures, while the top panel includes decorative sculpture depicting ethereal or mythological figures. The use of fine line work and shading suggests precision and skill in the creation of this intricate architectural plan or study.

artworks.title: Giuseppina Massimi, Principessa Lancellotti di Lauro
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil sketch showing the head and shoulders of a person. The person is positioned facing forward, slightly tilted to the left. They have distinct facial features: a straight nose, full lips, and large, expressive eyes. Their hair is styled in tight curls that frame the face, with some sections likely pinned up. The sketch captures no evident clothing details below the shoulders, and there are no visible accessories or objects being held. The background of the image is blank.

artworks.title: Dante and Virgil Riding on the Back of Geryon
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper, fragments of graphite borderlines at top, left, and bottom
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing figures riding a creature and a group of people engaged in a scene. Two figures are atop a mythical creature resembling a dragon with spiral details. The figures are dressed in flowing garments and appear to be in motion as they ride through clouds. Below them, a group of nude figures are shown in various poses, expressing movement and intensity. The drawing is filled with swirling lines that convey drama and tension.

artworks.title: A View across the Inn Valley to the Alps and Neubeuern
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a large tree in the foreground on the right. The terrain includes earthy browns and greens, leading to rolling hills with various trees in the background. The horizon is high in the image, showing distant mountains and a faint outline of a structure or settlement under a serene sky. The color palette is soft with earth tones, yellow, green, and blue, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The brushstrokes in the watercolor painting are delicate, capturing details of foliage, light, and shadow across the landscape.
